assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated textless 2D videogame UI sprite/material asset. Attached satchel is STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY. Front-on flat orthographic UI with perfectly straight parallel edges, no perspective. No letters, no symbols, no icons, no weapons, no text, no labels, no tiny filigree, no gears. Transparent exterior outside the sprite, solid opaque interior. Fill canvas with the sprite leaving just 2% transparent margin. Internal features only at perimeter, no internal subdivisions. Same soft illustrated style as reference, not photoreal, not pixel art. A SQUARE recessed cloth equipment compartment tile. Dark desaturated teal heavy canvas center, subtle large-scale weave rather than noisy grain. A THIN softly padded canvas rim with a single neat row of warm grey stitched threads on each edge. Low contrast, utilitarian shallow pocket, no metal corner badges, no straps. Canvas center accounts for 85% of area. Practical equipment bag slot. Square aspect.
